UPDATE: The NCP (SP) has extended its support to the BJP on the Delimitation Bill. This comes after the video was recorded.
The BJP’s proposed delimitation exercise could reshape the country's political map and change the balance of power between states. But does the BJP have the numbers to push it through? With the NDA falling short of the required majority, could parties like the DMK and NCP (SP) extend support if their demands are met? We explain the numbers, the political calculations and what is at stake in Delimitation 2.0.
